usage_distinction: AlignAIR DOWNLOADS germline DATA (sequences) and builds profile HMMs LOCALLY with pyhmmer (a vendored HMMER library, not an IMGT tool). It does NOT redistribute IMGT-hosted files and does NOT invoke IMGT web tools/services. IMGT tool-use terms (separate from the CC BY-4.0 data terms) therefore do not apply.
